title: compareVersions sorts 1.10.0 before 1.9.0
details: compareVersions compares version strings as plain text, so compareVersions("1.10.0", "1.9.0") returns -1. It must follow semver precedence: compare major.minor.patch as numbers; a version with a pre-release ("1.0.0-beta") sorts before the same version without one; pre-release identifiers compare left to right, numeric ones as numbers and always before alphanumeric ones, and when all shared identifiers are equal the longer list is greater (so alpha < alpha.1 < alpha.beta < beta < beta.2 < beta.11 < rc.1 < 1.0.0); build metadata after "+" is ignored.
